title: The query-log spool split counts consumed rows as waiting and rows of open sessions as waiting for delivery
goal: mon_querylog.spool_split never counts a tools row the consumed ledger lists as waiting, and the status line separates rows of still-open sessions from rows a delivery will take now.

run:
import sys,tempfile,json;sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import mon_querylog
from pathlib import Path
q=Path(tempfile.mkdtemp());sp=q/'spool';sp.mkdir()
row=lambda i:json.dumps({'id':i,'ts':'2026-11-01T10:00:00Z','surface':'kb_hook'})
(sp/'tools-2026-11-01.jsonl').write_text(row('r1')+chr(10)+row('r2')+chr(10))
(q/'consumed.json').write_text(json.dumps({'tools-2026-11-01.jsonl':['r1']}))
(sp/'s-open.jsonl').write_text(row('o1')+chr(10)+row('o2')+chr(10))
out=mon_querylog.spool_split(sp)
sys.exit(0 if out['waiting']==1 and 2 in [v for k,v in out.items() if k!='waiting'] else 1)
